en.intro: This JOYIN set includes five skeletons, each about 16 inches (40 cm) tall, with movable limbs and jaws and an attached string or hook. FeelBetter buys it from the overseas seller after you order and ships it to you in Korea.
highlights: Five skeletons in one pack let you build a whole scene instead of relying on a single prop.
Movable limbs and jaws allow custom poses, and the seller notes they stay in place once positioned.
Each skeleton has an attached string or hook, so hanging them takes very little setup.
Hang them in trees, on porches or windows, or set them on a table or in a graveyard scene.
The listing says the resin figures are designed to withstand various weather conditions, for indoor or outdoor use.

sections.p: Hang them from trees, porches or windows, or sit them on tables for a haunted house, graveyard scene or Halloween party. Their small size also suits party favours and detailed scenes.
The pack contains 5 resin skeletons, each about 16 inches (40.6 cm) tall and 4.7 inches (12 cm) wide, with a total weight of about 1.4 pounds (0.64 kg). Each comes with a string or hook for hanging.

cautions: Each figure is about 16 inches (40 cm) tall, so please check this against your display space.
The listing's age range is Adult; these are decorations.
